item: R688 known relays refused on the vLLM path and the pull queue
summary: The pull queue refuses an Ollama cloud name when it is submitted. Before each generation the vLLM path refuses an Ollama daemon carrying a cloud model or an alias of one, and a server whose model cards name OpenAI or LiteLLM as owner; a failing model list refuses too. Other local OpenAI-compatible servers run as before, and Settings says the app cannot see where they send text. SECURITY.md states the rule and what it cannot see.
